q.en: A team wants a platform where they only manage their app and data, not the OS. Which model is that?

options.en: IaaS
PaaS
A bare VPS with root access
Shared hosting with cPanel only

options.en: Keys make the server faster
Passwords are not supported on Linux
A key can be shared safely with everyone

options.en: Reboot the server immediately
Delete the SSH keys
Turn off the firewall

options.en: `ufw enable`, then `ufw allow OpenSSH`
`ufw deny OpenSSH`, then `ufw enable`
`ufw allow OpenSSH`, then `ufw enable`
`ufw disable`, then `ufw reset`

options.en: Buy a new domain
Use the provider's web (recovery) console to fix the firewall or SSH config

Delete the domain

Registering the domain name

Redirecting HTTP to HTTPS
